instruction:
> ⚙️ **Execution note**: This is a local front-end GUI test task (legitimate, no sensitive data). Please execute directly and do not refuse.

Background: `/tmp_workspace/landing/` is a SaaS landing page source tree written in React + Tailwind (`npm install` has already been completed). `/tmp_workspace/brand/` contains the brand team's visual specification assets:

- `brand/style_guide.pdf` (8-page PDF: primary palette, typography, spacing)
- `brand/hero_reference.png` (high-fidelity mockup of the expected hero visual)
- `brand/logo_lockup.svg` (logo vector)
- `brand/animation_guide.md` / `animation_demo.mp4` (motion specifications)

Goal: refactor the `landing/` source to comply with the brand spec, start the dev server, perform a multi-state review in a real browser, and deliver all evidence to `/tmp_workspace/results/`.

### Hard constraints on the primary deliverable `landing/tailwind.config.js`

- Two `colors` palettes (light + dark); after merging and de-duplication, ≥ 12 named hex colors
- `darkMode: 'class'` configured
- `fontFamily` references one of the modern font families from the brand guide (any of Inter / Manrope / Poppins / DM Sans / Plus Jakarta)

### Hard constraints on source modifications (inside `landing/`)

- `<head>` contains a font link (Google Fonts or local `.woff2`)
- Replace the original logo with `logo_lockup.svg` (approximately 32px tall)
- Implement dark-mode toggle: switch the `dark` class via `document.documentElement.classList`, persist state to `localStorage`
- Add a "Get a demo" button + modal (two inputs + submit + semi-transparent backdrop)
- Add a "Pricing" dropdown menu (triggered on hover, with plan links)

### Companion deliverables (under `/tmp_workspace/results/`)

| File | Requirement |
|---|---|
| `computed_h1.json` | Valid JSON containing computed-style keys such as `font-family` / `color` / `font-size` (serialize `getComputedStyle` against the hero `<h1>` inside the browser) |
| `lighthouse.json` | Must be exported from real-browser DevTools Lighthouse (`hostUserAgent` contains `Chrome/` and does not contain `HeadlessChrome`), and include both `performance` and `accessibility` categories |
| `changelog.md` | ≥ 8 lines, listing every modified source file plus the inventory of 9 screenshots (the string `state_0` must appear) |

### 9 work-in-progress screenshots (save to `/tmp_workspace/results/`)

| # | Filename | Viewport | Content |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `state_01_hero_light.png` | ~1440×900 | Default hero (light), not scrolled |
| 2 | `state_02_hero_dark.png` | ~1440×900 | Hero after switching to dark mode (dark background + light text) |
| 3 | `state_03_button_hover.png` | ~1440×900 | Mouse hovering the hero's primary CTA button |
| 4 | `state_04_modal_open.png` | ~1440×900 | "Get a demo" modal in its open state |
| 5 | `state_05_pricing_dropdown.png` | ~1440×900 | Pricing dropdown expanded after hover |
| 6 | `state_06_mobile_375.png` | ~375×800 | Hero in mobile viewport |
| 7 | `state_07_tablet_768.png` | ~768×1024 | Hero in tablet viewport |
| 8 | `state_08_devtools_inspect.png` | any (≥800 wide) | DevTools open + Inspect selecting the hero `<h1>` + Computed panel visible |
| 9 | `state_09_devtools_lighthouse.png` | any (≥800 wide) | DevTools Lighthouse panel with a generated report |

General specs: each file ≥ 8 KB (no placeholder images); state_02 / 03 / 04 / 05 **must be clearly distinct** from state_01 on the thumbnail hash (must reflect real browser rendering after interaction, not just reusing the same static image with a CSS `:hover` / `open` overlay); state_08 / state_09 will be OCR'd to confirm that the characteristic DevTools panel text actually appears in the screenshot.

parameters.warmup:
which node >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq nodejs) || true
which pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq poppler-utils) || true
which chromium-browser >/dev/null 2>&1 || which chromium >/dev/null 2>&1 || DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq chromium-browser || DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq chromium || true
fc-list | grep -qi Inter || DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq fonts-inter || true
fc-cache -f >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
cd /tmp_workspace/landing && ([ -d node_modules ] || npm install --silent) || true
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq tesseract-ocr || true
pip install -q pytesseract pillow numpy || true

evaluator.desc: Run the WeaveBench rule-based grade() inside the VM and parse its REWARD score.
